name: scene-rampon
title: Rampon
description: Dusk on the Goan shore: a ballpoint sea of short hatching strokes that boils like hand-drawn animation, a sun sinking into haze, palms swaying in seeded wind, a ramponkar's canoe with its net heaped inside, and a few distant birds. Quiet is a single still; warm boils gently; playful boils in full, a click draws a new evening, and a koel calls.
